Name: T's Greenhouse
Author: tikamin557
Description:
[center][quote][size=4]The original inspiration for the 10x10 layout comes from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2143]10x10 Greenhouse[/url].[/size][/quote][/center]

This mod offers a customizable greenhouse designed to be practical while preserving the vanilla atmosphere.

[size=4][b][color=#ffff00]Features[/color][/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Choose between the vanilla greenhouse size, a compact 10x10 planting area optimized for Iridium Sprinklers, or a spacious 15x15 layout.[/*]
[*]Adjusted the surrounding space to make planting fruit trees easier without making the greenhouse feel cramped.[/*]
[*]Removed obstacles that could interfere with movement around fruit trees.[/*]
[*]Widened the greenhouse exit to two tiles for easier access.[/*]
[*]Customize the flooring, planting area borders, window glass, and outside window views.[/*]
[*]Hide the default furniture, and move or hide the water trough.[/*]
[*]Adjust the saturation of custom textures to better match recolor mods.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b][color=#ffff00]Configuration[/color][/b][/size]
Most features can be customized through [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url].

You can also enable changeable flooring to decorate the greenhouse using flooring items, just like in the farmhouse.

[b]Note:[/b] Changing the greenhouse size after planting crops or placing objects may shift the planting area's position. Please check your greenhouse before changing the size.

[center][size=3](If you like this mod or any of the mods I've created, please consider endorsing it! Your support motivates me to keep making mods!)[/size]
